# Frames Compiler

[Morphis Frames](https://morphis-tech.com/products/frames.html) is a software tool for building technology agnostic applications. The GUI is implemented using a technology that provides support for different platforms meaning that programmers need to know only a single programming language.

This project, **Frames Compiler**, it's ment to add support for using the Frames language in NodeJS. For now, you will also need a Java Runtime to compile UI Interfaces.

# Installing

For the latest stable version:

```bash
npm install -g frames-compiler
```

# Contribute

There are many ways to contribute:

- Submit [issues](https://jira.morphis-tech.com/) and help us verify fixes as they are checked in.
- Review the source code changes.
- Engage with other Frames users and developers on StackOverflow.
- Read the [Language Reference](https://confluence.morphis-tech.com/display/FRAMES/Language+Reference).

# Usage

```bash
framesc -i example.xvc -o example.html
```
